row.body: The kitchen jar sits beside a rinse note for the grounds crew; the fish order was cancelled on the same afternoon.
row.title: The unfinished handoff

sidecar.gloss: A restaurant rinse note and an interrupted order connect a crew visit to routine service.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could have rinsed equipment after a closure, and the cancelled order does not identify what the crew carried.

row.body: The repair ticket orders the front doors open for pickup, but the locksmith billed for cutting off the back lock. Tomorrow’s lunch count is still pencilled in.
row.title: Kept from the drawer

sidecar.gloss: A repair bill records conflicting access instructions while the restaurant planned to reopen.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could have needed separate access to the building; the bill does not say who changed the locks or why.
